items.quote: So his servant ran him through, and he died.
items.contrast: The woman is mentioned only in Abimelek’s feared claim, whereas his servant, the armor-bearer, performs the fatal action.
items.reason: “A woman” is a plausible distractor because Abimelek mentions that attribution, but the narration explicitly says his servant ran him through and he died. The question clearly tests who actually carried out the killing.
